examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.
All right, here you go. There, look.

examples.trans: Your question is being sorted out, Klavdia Viktorovna! Can't you see I have a meeting?

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: female child; patronising when used to a teenager or adult

examples.trans: Girl, pass me the sugar, please.
A little girl is playing in the yard.

examples.text: Очень плохой кофе. Девочка, дай сахар, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: Very bad coffee. Girl, pass me the sugar, please.

related.gloss: to reach, walk as far as

заплакать.gloss: to start crying, to burst into tears

meanings.en: to start crying, to burst into tears

examples.text: Дима, что это с тобой? Ты чуть не заплакал?
examples.trans: Dima, what's wrong with you? Did you almost cry?

examples.text: Настя, если заплачешь, я тебя оштрафую!
examples.trans: Nastya, if you cry, I'll fine you!

examples.text: Не надо. Если не выпью, я заплачу от горя.
examples.trans: No need. If I don't drink, I'll cry from grief.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

избавиться.gloss: to get rid of, to be rid of

meanings.note: free oneself from someone or something

examples.text: Ты хотел избавиться от моей жены?
examples.trans: Did you want to get rid of my wife?

examples.text: Нам нужно срочно избавиться от этого старого дивана.
examples.trans: We urgently need to get rid of this old sofa.

examples.text: Аркаш, мне москвичи звонят каждый день. Может, всё-таки передумаем?
examples.trans: Arkasha, the people from Moscow call me every day. Maybe we should reconsider after all?

meanings.note: Как вы знаете = as you know.

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: В любой момент = at any moment.

examples.text: Любая обезьяна эти выборы выиграет! Ты что, хуже обезьяны?
examples.trans: Any monkey will win this election! What, are you worse than a monkey?

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!
Here, for example, is the boy.
Let's take, for instance, this case.

examples.text: А мы многое что можем сделать. Вот, например, мальчик.
examples.trans: Oh, there's plenty we can do. Here, for example, is the boy.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
hesitation, at the start of a sentence

examples.trans: She found us at the new place.

I love our town very much.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.en: to try, to have a go

examples.text: Как я могу это забыть? Ну, давай попробуем.
examples.trans: How can I forget that? Well, let's try.

при.gloss: in the presence of, by, at

meanings.en: in the presence of, at, attached to
meanings.note: + prepositional; ни при чём = has nothing to do with it / not to blame

examples.trans: And what does Lyolya have to do with it?

examples.text: Всё, я ухожу. Ребёнок ни при чём. Передай это Алексею.
examples.trans: That's it, I'm leaving. The child isn't to blame. Give this to Alexei.
I'll give you a fit right now!

examples.text: У неё был приступ, но ничего страшного.
examples.trans: She had an attack, but it's nothing serious.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

examples.text: Садитесь и держите дверь. Никто не войдёт.
examples.trans: Sit down and hold the door. Nobody will come in.

meanings.note: once; что скажешь? = what do you say?

examples.trans: Tell us, when will your programme be out?

examples.trans: I wanted to make them memorise a poem by Blok!

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!
